Four more apps, made with the same care
If you enjoy reading with Quill, you might like keeping track of your money with Mynt, learning Japanese with Hajime, focusing with Sessions and cooking with Ryori.
Customizable cycles and smart intervals that work out when to trigger long breaks.
6 curated ambient sounds with adaptive ducking and haptic feedback.
Heatmaps, total focus time and your peak productivity hours at a glance.
Built to resist aggressive battery optimization, so your timer never drops.
8 color themes, dynamic Material You, OLED black mode and 6 font options.
Name your sessions to track and review exactly what you worked on.
A featured carousel, a cuisine and a category of the day, and a Surprise me button for when you can\'t decide.
Browse recipes by category, cuisine or ingredient, or search for one by name.
Clear step-by-step instructions, with ingredients you can tick off as you go.
Non-alcoholic drinks sit right next to the meals, so there\'s something for every glass.
One switch hides meat and seafood across the whole app.
Recipes you\'ve opened are saved on your device and load instantly, even without a connection.
Tell Mynt what you spent the way you\'d tell a friend. Several things in one sentence become separate entries.
Say who you lent to or borrowed from, and when they paid you back. Mynt keeps every balance straight.
Split a dinner or a trip between friends just by saying who was there and what it cost.
Ask how much you spent on food this month, or who still owes you, and get an answer straight away.
Everything Mynt understood is shown first, so you can fix an amount or a category before it\'s saved.
When something\'s missing, Mynt asks you, and can read its questions aloud so you can answer hands-free.
Hiragana and katakana first, then kanji, words and sentences, one short lesson at a time.
N5 to N1 kanji with readings, meanings, parts, common words and example sentences with furigana.
Spaced repetition brings each item back just before you\'d forget it, so what you learn sticks.
Ask anything about Japanese and get stories, sentence breakdowns and quizzes built from what you\'ve learned.
Every kana, kanji, word and sentence can be read aloud in a Japanese voice.
Streaks, a study heatmap, your trickiest mix-ups and progress through every JLPT level.
Quill, Mynt, Hajime, Sessions and Ryori are made by YugenTech: small, thoughtful apps built to make everyday moments a little calmer.
Four more apps, made with the same care.

Aira locks her knowledge to your exact reading progress to protect the story.
I\'m here for the small moments: a name you\'ve forgotten, a word you don\'t know, a scene you want to picture. Ask, and I\'ll get you back to the story.
Aira doesn\'t guess. Her answers are strictly retrieved from the actual passages of the book you are reading.
She knows exactly which chapter you\'re on and remembers your ongoing conversation for a natural chat experience.
Aira\'s knowledge is strictly locked to your reading progress. She will never reveal events or twists from chapters you haven\'t read.
The beautiful illustrations and doodles used throughout Quill are created by Pablo Stanley. Big thanks for his amazing contributions to the open design community!
Some of the animated icons used throughout Quill are provided by Lordicon, a library of high-quality animated assets for creators.

The source code is available on GitHub. You are free to use, study, change and share it, as long as anything you share stays open source under the same license. The Quill name and logo are not included.
Sources has a fresh new look, with a friendlier way to import books from your device, cover previews from each catalogue, and a count of how many of their books are already in your library.
Your profile card in More is more compact, with a bigger avatar. Tap the avatar to pick a new one from a sheet, or the pencil to change your name, without leaving the page.
Aira\'s answers now flow in a few words at a time, and the conversation glides up gently as they appear, both in the chat and in the quick panel while you read.
Standard Ebooks covers now load as lighter thumbnails, so Discover, your Library, and book pages fill in much quicker.

Your daily reading reminder now shows when it rings, like \"Every evening at 7:00 PM\". Playful reminders are quieter and never more than one a day, with a few kind words if you\'ve been away for a while.
Smoother, consistent fades behind the top bars across the app, Aira\'s quick panel now resizes back to its full height, and the sign-in spinner shows only on the button you tapped.

Aira has been rebuilt from the ground up. She knows whether you\'re asking about your book or anything else, answers straight from the pages you\'ve read, never spoils what\'s ahead, and can read her answers aloud.
Select any word or passage while reading and Aira is right there. Define words, explain tricky lines, or find out why a moment matters, without leaving the book.
Select a character\'s name to recall who they are or see what they\'re up to lately. Always spoiler-free.
Turn any passage into a painted illustration. Your images are kept in a Visuals gallery, and tapping one takes you right back to the passage it came from.
A smoother way to select text, plus highlights you can revisit from one place and jump straight back to in the book.
A refreshed reading screen with new reading settings, a cleaner table of contents, a warm night light, and page turning with your volume keys.
Set the mood with six soundscapes, from gentle rain to a crackling fireplace. Preview them before you play, or have them start automatically when you open a book.
Pick a time for a daily reading reminder, or let playful nudges help you keep your streak going.
A redesigned Discover tab, better Project Gutenberg and Standard Ebooks browsing, a quick way to add your own books, and categories you can reorder by dragging.
See your reading time, streak, peak reading hours, favorite authors, and how you read with Aira, all on a refreshed Insights screen.
A brand new app icon and splash screen, the new Harbor color theme, and a polished feel across the whole app.

A fresh welcome and sign-in, a redesigned Appearance screen, calmer loading, and Quill now speaks ten languages.
Pick from ten languages anytime under More > Appearance > Language. Quill switches straight away.

Quill now speaks ten languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Hindi, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese. Pick yours under More › Appearance › Language and the whole app switches straight away.
A new first-run tour on a calm, still background with a back button to step back, plus redesigned sign-in and sign-up screens. Replay the tour anytime from More.
Colour themes as cards with a palette disc for each, little phone previews for light and dark, a starry AMOLED card, and a gentle fade across the screen as your colours change.
Covers and catalogues now pulse softly while they load, and Standard Ebooks and Project Gutenberg lay out their books straight away instead of showing a spinner.

Tap Guest on the sign-in screen to start reading right away. As a guest, your library stays on your phone and never goes to the cloud. Aira and Pro need an account. Leaving guest mode deletes your library, so you can export it on the way out.
Back Up and Bring It Along

Guests can export their books, progress, highlights and reading history to a file from More › Backup, and import it on any phone. Signed in? Import that file in More and it syncs to your account. Importing never doubles anything up.
Guest mode keeps everything on your phone, but Aira answers from the cloud, so she needs an account to work. Getting there takes a minute, and your library comes with you.
